DecryptTruck third-party component

Pinned Windows release asset:
  decrypt_truck_windows.exe
Expected SHA-256:
  7d8521e482646f11ac986d97063dbe0cc8c7b98716a6fe02cf7b621c19a64e2d

NMC SCS LAUNCHER uses this component only as a separate process to decode
ETS2/ATS SII save files into textual SiiNunit form. The original save is not
passed as the decoder output target; decoding first happens into a temporary
file and the NMC backup/validation pipeline controls any later replacement.
